integrity: All distributional claims are proved analytically. The reproducibility program provides finite consistency checks only; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Common positive integer Erlang shapes only; different rates allowed; the nondegenerate mixing probability is necessary. No claim on noninteger or unequal shapes. A relevant 2015 article PDF was incompletely accessible, so historical priority is not established exhaustively.
title: The one-stage infinite-divisibility boundary for signed Erlang mixtures
